text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh. My head hurts. It hurts so much.
Oh no.
This is certainly a pickle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right after we wrap up a meeting, Aston
Machan
suddenly adopts an affected air
and claims she
isn't feeling well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm dandy. And do you know why? It's
because
Whatchamacallit Co's
Migraine-B-Gone has got
my back!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Well? What do you think of my acting?
I think
it's only a matter of time until the
commercial
offers start—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Actually... the headache part wasn't an
act...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She quickly takes some actual
medicine... but the
headache proves to
be stubborn.
